dedupe_keys.name: bts port performance freight statistics program data

description: The Bureau of Transportation Statistics' Port Performance Freight Statistics Program publishes data on the capacity and throughput of US ports on the BTS data portal. The Port Data summary table gives port characteristics by port, region, state, reporting year, cargo type and trade type, with volume, national ranking and percent change (8,386 rows), and companion datasets cover the top 25 container ports by TEU, the top 25 ports by dry bulk tonnage, monthly TEU data, containerised import and export value and weight by port, the number of terminals handling container ships with on-dock rail, air drafts of the limiting bridge over navigation channels at the top 25 container ports, and cruise ship arrivals and passengers. Coverage is national, for the leading US container, tonnage and dry bulk ports. The data are free and in the public domain on data.bts.gov, with CSV and JSON export and an API, updated annually and in part monthly. Caveats: most tables cover only the top 25 ports in each category, several draw on other agencies' sources such as Census Bureau trade data, and the program's narrative pages on bts.gov refused automated access on 2026-09-26. The throughput, berth and air draft data support capacity planning and network flow models of port systems and hazard exposure studies of ports. It is related to the supply chain and freight indicators and the Freight Analysis Framework.
